elements.texte:
[cheerful] The warehouse team uses a dashboard to track how orders are progressing.

It wants to find there the IDs of the orders being processed and of those already shipped.

So we need one row per status, with the list of the matching order IDs.

Everything starts from the orders table, which holds one row per order.

elements.texte:
[cheerful] Group concat gathers a group’s values into a single cell.

In group concat, we give the column ID,

Then the separator comma space: a comma followed by a space.

The IDs of the 5 orders being processed

Are gathered into a single cell: “12, 13, 14, 15, 16”.

Like count, group concat is an aggregate function:

It combines the values of several rows to produce a single result per group.
